heading: 1.01.010 - Code adoption—Reference generally.
text:
This compilation and codification of the general ordinances of the City of Las Vegas
is hereby declared to be and shall hereafter constitute the official Municipal Code
of the City of Las Vegas. Any reference to the number of any section contained herein
shall be understood to refer to the position of the same under its appropriate Title
heading, its chapter heading and its section heading and to the general penalty clause
relating thereto, as well as to the section itself, when reference is made to this
Code by title in any legal document.

(Ord. 2232 § 1, 1981)

heading: 1.01.020 - Repeal of general ordinances.
text:
All general ordinances of the City passed prior to the adoption of this Code are hereby
repealed, except such as are referred to herein as being still in force or are by
necessary implication herein reserved from repeal subject to the saving clauses contained
in the following Sections of this Chapter. Excluded from such repeal are the following
ordinances: tax levy ordinances, appropriation ordinances, ordinances relating to
boundaries and annexations, franchise ordinances and other ordinances granting special
rights to persons or corporations, contract ordinances and ordinances authorizing
the execution of a contract or the issuance of warrants, salary ordinances, ordinances
establishing, naming or vacating streets, alleys or other public places, special improvement
district ordinances, bond ordinances, ordinances relating to elections, ordinances
relating to the transfer or acceptance of real estate by or from the City, and all
special ordinances.

(Ord. 2233 § 1(part), 1981: prior code § 1-2-1)

heading: 1.01.030 - Utility, street and railroad ordinances.
text:
No ordinance relating to railroads or railroad crossings with streets and other public
ways, or relating to the conduct, duties, service or rates of public utilities, shall
be repealed by virtue of Section 1.01.020, excepting as this Code may contain provisions for such matters, in which case the
provisions of this Code shall be considered as amending such ordinance or ordinances
in respect of such provisions only.

(Ord. 2233 § 1(part), 1981: prior code § 1-2-2)
